title: FlowLOB: Efficient and Controllable Limit Order Book Generation with Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2608.13096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Limit order book (LOB) simulators are most useful to practitioners when they combine realistic market dynamics, computationally efficient sampling, controllable scenario generation, and the ability to generalize beyond the instruments seen during training---properties that existing agent-based and deep generative simulators provide only partially. We present \textbf{FlowLOB}, a conditional \textbf{flow}-matching generator of \textbf{LOB} trajectories, trained on multiple Hong Kong Exchange (HKEX) symbols at three sampling frequencies ($0.1$s, $1$s, $10$s) in tick-relative representation that transfers to unseen instruments. Because flow and diffusion models admit a common formulation, we train both with identical data, architecture, and budget, and sample both through the same fixed-step ODE solvers, yielding a controlled comparison of sampling efficiency and fidelity. Flow matching attains its best quality with only $10$ ODE-solver step

translated_title: FlowLOB：基于流匹配的高效可控限价订单簿生成
translated_abstract: 限价订单簿（LOB）模拟器在结合真实市场动态、计算高效采样、可控场景生成以及超越训练中见过的工具进行泛化时，对从业者最为有用——这些属性在现有的基于代理和深度生成的模拟器中仅部分提供。我们提出\textbf{FlowLOB}，一种基于条件\textbf{流}匹配的LOB轨迹生成器，使用多个香港交易所（HKEX）符号在三个采样频率（$0.1$秒、$1$秒、$10$秒）下以tick相对表示进行训练，并能迁移到未见过的工具。由于流模型和扩散模型具有共同的公式化形式，我们用相同的数据、架构和预算训练两者，并通过相同的固定步长ODE求解器进行采样，从而对采样效率和保真度进行受控比较。流匹配仅需$10$步ODE求解器即可达到最佳质量。
tldr: 本文提出FlowLOB，一种基于流匹配的限价订单簿生成器，通过条件生成和跨频率训练实现高效采样与可控场景生成，并能泛化到未见过的交易工具，且仅需少量ODE步骤即可达到高质量。
en_tdlr: This paper presents FlowLOB, a flow-matching-based limit order book generator that achieves efficient sampling and controllable scenario generation through conditional generation and multi-frequency training, while generalizing to unseen instruments with only a few ODE steps.
